precision_gate.co2_additional_relative_error_gate: retains the original q* <= 5% and LDF-next <= 0.1% p95 relative-error requirements
precision_gate.reason: tail relative errors are unstable for trace adsorbate loadings; scale-normalized absolute error is reported against the component register range, while raw relative errors remain visible

sequential_five_component_accounting.accounting: five individually compiled clean modules, executed sequentially with arithmetic workspace reuse and all five loading inputs/outputs retained
sequential_five_component_accounting.interpretation: modular upper accounting before cross-component cancellation, routing, transport, valve/tank arithmetic, and repeated time integration

cleanliness_by_construction.per_component: compute competitive denominator and component numerator; compute reciprocal, q*, and LDF update; copy next loading; reverse every work operation
cleanliness_by_construction.retained: 18-bit pressure/composition inputs and each selected-width current/next component-loading register

claim_boundary.supported: physical-cache precision screen and all-to-all u/CX compilation of clean one-cell, one-second competitive-Langmuir/LDF updates for H2, CO2, CH4, CO, and N2
claim_boundary.unsupported: gas-phase transport, pressure evolution, valve or tank balances, adaptive integration, a complete adsorption phase or cyclic PSA oracle, routed hardware feasibility, or quantum advantage
